record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, increase the existing causal recent-four-state pooling contribution from 0.2 to 0.35: use 0.65*h_t + 0.35*mean(last four nonpadding states ending at t). The previous pooling gain motivates testing stronger recent-context smoothing. Apply at every training position and the final real inference position; synchronize predictor metadata. Keep truncation, embeddings, backbone, scoring, loss and optimizer fixed.
